Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Defines a compiler-checked PostgreSQL aggregate transition.

```csharp
public interface IPgAggregate<TState, TArgs>
```

Type parameters:

`TState`

The state, including its SQL nullability.

`TArgs`

One input, a tuple of inputs, or [ValueTuple](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.valuetuple) for no inputs.

Apply [PgAggregateAttribute](/api/ankus.pgaggregateattribute/) to the implementing class or struct.
Tuple elements become separate SQL arguments. Arrays remain single SQL values.
Additional interfaces supply optional final, parallel and moving capabilities.
